content.short: Ekubo is a high-performance AMM on Starknet, featuring concentrated liquidity and an extensible singleton design.
content.description:
Ekubo is a next-generation decentralized exchange and Automated Market Maker (AMM) purpose-built for the Starknet ecosystem. It introduces a highly efficient singleton architecture, where all pools are managed within a single smart contract to minimize gas costs and maximize capital efficiency. By implementing concentrated liquidity, Ekubo allows LPs to provide capital within specific price ranges, significantly enhancing the depth of the market and reducing slippage for traders compared to traditional AMM models.

The protocol is designed with extensibility at its core, utilizing a powerful "hooks" system that allows developers to build custom logic directly onto the exchange. This flexibility enables the creation of complex financial instruments, dynamic fee structures, and automated trading strategies. As a leading liquidity layer on Starknet, Ekubo combines advanced mathematics with a developer-friendly approach to drive the next wave of DeFi innovation on Layer 2.
